info.title: Zenvoices Universal API
info.description: Zenvoices is an accounts payable and financial operations platform with a public API for administrations, accounts, transactions, inbox documents, master data, and webhook subscriptions.

get.description: Retrieves an account from Zenvoices by code.

parameters.name: connectionId
parameters.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Comma-separated response fields to include.
